llm_response.reason: The domain zacpinnick.shop was registered extremely recently (May 2025) and has no visible legitimate company information or customer service details, with all contacts hidden. The website pretends to be a European/Italian e-commerce shop selling Desigual apparel, but the registration is with a Hong Kong registrar and there is no verifiable relationship with the brand. It displays classic scam characteristics: ambiguous and generic policy references, lack of transparency, offers of branded goods likely without authorization, and website content designed to trigger trust and urgency. There are no external links to privacy policies or proper business contacts. These factors, especially the domain age and concealed ownership, strongly indicate a scam.
